body.text: You can view each Pokémon’s EVs and IVs in its summary. Open the Stats page to see them.
lines: You can view each Pokémon’s EVs and IVs
in its summary. Open the Stats page to
see them.

body.text: IVs are individual values from 0 to 31. EVs grow through training. Both contribute to a Pokémon’s stats.
lines: IVs are individual values from 0 to 31.
EVs grow through training. Both

body.text: L shows EVs. R shows IVs. Select restores the stats. You can also view these values in the PC.
lines: L shows EVs. R shows IVs. Select

body_l_equals_a.text: L=A disables these L/R controls. Choose Normal in Options to view EVs and IVs. Select restores the stats.

body.text: Nel riepilogo puoi leggere gli EV e gli IV di ogni Pokémon. Apri la pagina Dati per consultarli.

body.text: Gli IV vanno da 0 a 31. Gli EV aumentano con l’allenamento. Entrambi influiscono sui parametri del Pokémon.
